clue.text: Chestnut one replaced with round bed cover

indicators.note: the letter for one is swapped out and the letter for round put in its place

parts.note: a chestnut is an old, overused joke or saying, a cliche
one is the Roman numeral I
a round shape is the letter O

explanation.surface: An old joke has been swapped for a circular blanket on the bed.
explanation.walkthrough: The bed here is a garden bed: a CLOCHE is a bell-shaped glass or plastic cover put over plants.
explanation.definitionFit: A cloche is a protective glass dome placed over seedlings in a garden bed.

clue.text: Not recorded as I speak the philosophy of the hedonist?

parts.note: a live broadcast goes out as it happens, not taped beforehand
something true as I speak holds right now, at present

explanation.surface: Is broadcasting in real time the creed of the pleasure-seeker?
explanation.definitionFit: A hedonist seeks pleasure now and ignores the future, the classic carpe diem attitude.

clue.text: Banter by creep gets the bird

parts.note: chaff is light-hearted teasing talk
to inch is to creep forward slowly

explanation.surface: Someone whose teasing comes with sycophancy gets jeered off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gets the bird' sounds like being booed, but the bird is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The chaffinch is a common European finch, a small songbird.

clue.text: One fleeing his country before catching plane

indicators.note: the first piece holds the second inside it, as if catching it

parts.note: ere is an old word for before
a MiG is a Russian fighter plane

explanation.surface: A refugee is seen just ahead of boarding an aircraft.
explanation.definitionFit: An emigre is someone who has left their native country, often for political reasons.

clue.text: Reported boost given to ostentatiously holy ancient site of Greece

indicators.note: reported means the word is said out loud, giving a sound-alike spelling

parts.note: a fillip is a stimulus or boost
pi is slang short for pious, showily religious

explanation.surface: A rumoured lift is given to a showily devout old Greek site.
explanation.walkthrough: PI is a schoolboy abbreviation of pious, meaning sanctimonious.
explanation.definitionFit: Philippi was a city of ancient Macedonia, in northern Greece, scene of a famous battle.

clue.text: Chanted by audience impatient with compére of satire show, to ruin any chance of success?

definitions.text: Chanted by audience impatient with compére of satire show
definitions.meaning: a crowd fed up with the host demands that the satirists, the mockers, be brought on

definitions.text: to ruin any chance of success?
definitions.meaning: an idiom for jinxing or thwarting someone's plans

explanation.surface: A restless studio crowd shouts for the comedians, wrecking the evening.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to spoil or put a stop to someone's prospects.

clue.text: Private advanced in middle of another spell of rain

indicators.note: one piece is put inside the other, in its centre
another spelling of the word rain means its letters rearranged

parts.note: came means advanced, moved forward

explanation.surface: A soldier pressed on through yet another wet period.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Another spell of' means the same four letters spelt differently, giving INRA. 'Private' looks like a soldier but is the adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: In camera is a legal phrase meaning in private, with the public excluded.

clue.text: Me, pretentious, girl? Au contraire, in a manner of speaking

indicators.note: French for on the contrary, telling us to read the pieces the opposite way round

parts.note: moi is the affected way of saying me
Di is a girl's name, short for Diana

explanation.surface: A preening girl's French affectation: 'on the contrary', she says.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Au contraire' turns MOIDI round. The definition 'in a manner of speaking' stands for a manner of speaking, the 'in a' being part of the phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom is a turn of phrase, a characteristic way of saying something.

clue.text: Stop wrenching pendant out!

indicators.note: wrenching twists the letters violently into a new order

explanation.surface: A cry to halt someone ripping off a necklace.
explanation.definitionFit: To put an end to something is to stop or terminate it.

clue.text: A TV is deployed (air conditioned inside) for restricted flight area manager

indicators.note: one set of letters sits inside the other
deployed means the letters are spread out and rearranged
conditioned means the letters are altered into a new order

explanation.surface: A television set up in an air-conditioned control room for an airfield.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Deployed' gives AVIST and 'conditioned' gives IAR. The bracket hints at an air-conditioned control tower, but the aviarist manages birds, not aircraft.
explanation.definitionFit: An aviarist keeps an aviary, an enclosure where birds fly within limits.

clue.text: Material from tip in east European republic reduced

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: the Czech Republic shortened to its abbreviation CZ
a tip is a hint or piece of advice

explanation.surface: Fabric comes from a rubbish dump in a diminished Eastern Bloc state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tip' could be a dump; here it is a hint.
explanation.definitionFit: Chintz is a glazed printed cotton fabric, often floral.

clue.text: See 2
It hides in another's shell, head on pillar; it has apple

parts.note: a herm is a square pillar topped by a carved head, originally of Hermes
a crab is a crab apple

explanation.surface: Some creature has a column for a head and an apple in its possession.
explanation.definitionFit: This crustacean lives in empty gastropod shells to protect its soft body.

clue.text: Very eastern, wearing body tubing

parts.note: if you are in something you are wearing it

explanation.surface: Extremely oriental clothing for a body pipe.
explanation.definitionFit: Veins are the vessels carrying blood back to the heart.

clue.text: Dying to ridicule entering bank

indicators.note: the second piece goes into the first

parts.note: a mound is a bank of earth
to rib is to tease or mock

explanation.surface: A person keen to jeer, walking into a bank.
explanation.definitionFit: Moribund means at the point of death, dying out.

clue.text: Coarse group often used to go online

parts.note: broad humour is coarse or vulgar
a band is a group of people or musicians

explanation.surface: A rough crowd that frequently surfs the internet.
explanation.definitionFit: Broadband is the high-speed connection most homes use for internet access.

clue.text: Decline to speak about a no good uprising

indicators.note: the first piece goes round the others

parts.note: to state is to say or declare

indicators.note: in a down clue, uprising means the letters are read upwards, backwards

explanation.surface: Refusing to discuss a failed rebellion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Decline' as a verb means deteriorate; it is not refusal.
explanation.definitionFit: To stagnate is to stop developing and so fall into decline.

clue.text: Energy wasted at 100mph, I pronounced

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy

indicators.note: wasted means the letters are ruined and reassembled

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for 100, and mph stays as written

explanation.surface: A driver admits squandering fuel at a hundred miles an hour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wasted' turns AT, C, MPH and I into MPHATIC.
explanation.definitionFit: Pronounced, as in a pronounced limp, means marked or strongly emphatic.

clue.text: What lovers get for breakfast?

parts.note: cereal grain eaten as porridge, with a nod to the slang of getting one's share of sex

explanation.surface: What a couple eat in the morning.
explanation.definitionFit: Porridge is made from this grain, and getting one's share is slang for sex.

clue.text: More relaxed prison

explanation.definitionFit: Cooler is both the comparative of cool, calm, and slang for a jail.

clue.text: Wrestling rag dolls, then, produces a good wrestling grip

indicators.note: wrestling the letters forces them into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Grappling with soft toys gives a strong hold.
explanation.definitionFit: A stranglehold is a grip round the neck, and figuratively complete control.

clue.text: A&E not involved in dancer getting out of bed

indicators.note: these letters are taken out of the dancer's name

parts.note: Fred Astaire was the famous American dancer

explanation.surface: Casualty staff are not called in for a dancer rising in the morning.
explanation.walkthrough: A&E is the British hospital emergency department.
explanation.definitionFit: Astir means up and about, out of bed and moving.

clue.text: Bonus puzzle, lacking number and name

indicators.note: the abbreviations are left out of the word

parts.note: to nonplus is to puzzle or baffle

explanation.surface: An extra crossword without its digits and title.
explanation.definitionFit: A plus is an advantage or added extra, a bonus.

clue.text: South African plant for a meal

parts.note: pro means in favour of, for
tea is an evening meal in Britain

explanation.surface: A Cape flower is to be served up at dinner.
explanation.definitionFit: The protea is a showy flowering shrub, national flower of South Africa.

clue.text: One of its three spoken component parts

definitions.text: One of its three spoken component parts

parts.words: One of its three spoken component parts
parts.note: the word itself has three such units when said, so each one is an example of what it names

explanation.surface: A piece of a word, pronounced.
explanation.definitionFit: A syllable is a unit of pronunciation, and this word is made of three of them.

clue.text: Want river to flow back to the east of Lincoln city

indicators.note: in an across answer, east of means placed after

parts.note: Abe is the nickname of Abraham Lincoln

indicators.note: the pieces are read backwards

parts.note: need means want

explanation.surface: Wanting a river to run backwards east of Lincoln.
explanation.walkthrough: Lincoln looks like the English city, but it is the president.
explanation.definitionFit: Aberdeen is a city in north-east Scotland.

clue.text: Possible follower of horse god having meal

parts.note: Ra is the Egyptian sun god
a dish is a course or meal

explanation.surface: A horse deity is eating.
explanation.walkthrough: Horseradish: the answer can follow 'horse' to make a word.
explanation.definitionFit: Horseradish is a pungent root, so this vegetable can follow the word horse.
